2 نمّس عَلَيْهِ الأَمْرَ , (A, * TA,) inf. n. تَنْمِيسٌ,
(A, K,) He concealed from him the thing, or affair; or made it dubious, or confused, to him; syn. لَبَّسَهُ. (A, K, * TA.) See also 1, first signification. ＝
-A2- نمّس بِصَاحِبِهِ He calumniated his companion; syn. نَمَّ بِهِ. (A.) See also 1. ＝
-A3- نمّس شَعَرُهُ His hair became befouled by oil. (M) See also 1, last sentence.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
